definitions.explanation: A set of rules or terms that members of an organization, users of a service, or parties to an agreement must follow. Commonly seen in terms of service for websites and apps, and in the bylaws of organizations.

examples.japanese: {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}に{同意|どうい}する。
examples.english: I agree to the terms of use.

examples.japanese: {規約|きやく}に{違反|いはん}した{場合|ばあい}、アカウントが{停止|ていし}されます。
examples.english: If you violate the terms, your account will be suspended.

examples.japanese: マンションの{管理|かんり}{規約|きやく}で{ペット}の{飼育|しいく}が{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Keeping pets is prohibited under the condominium management bylaws.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}: terms of use/service
- {管理|かんり}{規約|きやく}: management bylaws
- {規約|きやく}に{同意|どうい}する: to agree to the terms
- {規約|きやく}に{違反|いはん}する: to violate the terms
- {規約|きやく}を{改定|かいてい}する: to revise the terms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {約款|やっかん}: formal contract terms (insurance, banking — more technical)
- {規則|きそく}: rules, regulations (broader scope, institutional)
- {契約|けいやく}: contract (a binding agreement between parties)
